(2) Any association or body of individual citizens
of India calling itself a political party and intending to be
declared a local political party may, at any time, make an
application to the Commission for declaration as a local
political party.
(3) Any such application under rule (2) shall be signed
by the General Secretary, or if there is no General Secretary,
the Secretary of the association or body and shall contain the
following particulars, –
(a) the name of the association or body,
